youtubeDescription: Explore the My Aquariums tab — a local-first logbook designed for precision and ease. Track your tanks, fish, and care routines with layouts and tools that adapt to your workflow. Perfect for aquarists of all levels.

beats.onScreen: Echo swims by, introducing the episode.
beats.narration: Welcome to My Aquariums — your tank logbook, done right.

beats.onScreen: Show the List layout, then switch to Tree hierarchy view.
beats.narration: Your tanks are organized with three layout choices. List view keeps things simple. Tree view maps your facility, room by room — even rack by rack — with health flags at every level.

beats.onScreen: Show Quick Log drawer with water test options and color-coded ranges.
beats.narration: Quick Log lets you record a water test or care action in seconds. Safe ranges are color-coded, so you know at a glance how your tank is doing.

beats.onScreen: Demonstrate bulk logging for a rack and show saved templates.
beats.narration: Bulk logging saves time. Apply actions to a tank, rack, or room at once. Feed, water change, treatment — all with your saved templates.

beats.onScreen: Open the inline Add Tank drawer and add a tank.
beats.narration: Adding a new tank or fish is quick and inline. No extra screens or steps.

beats.onScreen: Scan a tank QR code with a camera and jump to its details.
beats.narration: Each tank can have its own QR label. Scan to jump directly to that tank's details.

beats.onScreen: Show tank details: About tab for casual mode, Overview tab for pro mode.
beats.narration: Tank details adapt to your style. Casual mode keeps it simple. Pro mode gives you telemetry grids, specimen tools, and detailed histories.

beats.onScreen: Open the Share to Reef button and post a tank update.
beats.narration: The Share to Reef button lets you post updates to your social Current. Show off your progress or ask for advice.

beats.onScreen: Highlight embedded tools: Tank Cam setup, Care Coach, Fry Nursery.
beats.narration: Embedded tools are here when you need them. From Tank Cam setup to Fry Nursery, it’s all built in.

beats.onScreen: Return to Echo companion and sidebar widgets.
beats.narration: Echo is always here to keep you company, alongside widgets like the Zone Leaderboard and Reward Credits.

beats.onScreen: Echo waves goodbye as Poseidon closes.
beats.narration: Try My Aquariums today. Your tanks deserve the care you give them.
